7388.subject: Christian Religious Knowledge (CRK)
7388.question_text: Who is being referred to here? 'But he went out and began to talk freely about it, and to spread the news, so that Jesus could no the country; and people came to him from every quarter'.
7388.explanation:
This passage refers to the Gerasene demoniac (also known as the Gadarene demoniac), whose story is found in Mark 5:20 (RSV):

  • "And he went away and began to proclaim in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him; and all men marveled."

The man, who had been healed of demon possession by Jesus, went out and spread the news about what Jesus had done for him. As a result, people from all over the region came to see Jesus, and He could no longer enter the town openly. This passage fits the description of the Gerasene demoniac's actions after his healing.

7417.subject: Christian Religious Knowledge (CRK)
7417.question_text: Which of the following was NOT one of the decisions of the Jerusalem Council communicated to Gentile Christians?
7417.explanation:
The Jerusalem council decided that Gentiles who converted to Christianity were not obligated to keep most of the fasts, and other specific rituals, including the rules concerning the circumcision of males. They basically convened to decide whether or not gentile converts to the Church should be required to obey the law of Moses.

The main decisions reached were; The Gentiles will have to;

1. Abstain from food sacrificed to idols
2. Abstain from blood
3. Abstain from the meat of strangled animals
4. Abstain from sexual immorality.
